# Woodpile: six 1.1 m logs stacked 3-2-1 along X, pale cut ends, and a chopping stump. Up Z.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.545 0.427 0.612
material new Ends --base-color 0.949 0.827 0.671 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name L0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0 -0.3 0.15 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name L1 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0 0 0.15 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name L2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0 0.3 0.15 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name L3 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0.04 -0.15 0.41 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name L4 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location -0.03 0.15 0.41 --rotation 0 90 0
add mesh cylinder --name L5 --vertices 8 --radius 0.15 --depth 1.1 --location 0.02 0 0.67 --rotation 0 90 0
select L0 L1 L2 L3 L4 L5
active L0
join
rename L0 Logs
apply --rotation
material assign Bark
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.x) > 0.9"
material assign Ends
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Stump --vertices 8 --radius 0.3 --depth 0.45 --location 1.05 0.1 0.225
material assign Bark
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Ends
mode object
select all
shade flat
export woodpile.glb
